sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's mechanics are simple yet challenging, requiring players to time their jumps and movements perfectly to avoid collisions and collect power-ups. One of the key mechanics of the game is the seahorse's jump ability, which can be used to propel the seahorse through the air and avoid obstacles.

The game's obstacles are varied and challenging, ranging from seaweed-covered rocks to schools of angry fish. Players must use their timing and reflexes to avoid these obstacles and make it to the next level. As players progress through the game, the obstacles become increasingly difficult, requiring players to think strategically and adapt their gameplay accordingly.
